Why It Matters

Your Donation in Action

100% of donations go toward tree planting, seedling distribution, and environmental education across Nigeria.

Mangrove Restoration

Restoring critical mangrove ecosystems across the Niger Delta region to protect coastlines and marine biodiversity.

₦500 = 1 tree

Community Empowerment

Training communities in sustainable agriculture, environmental conservation, and tree care practices.

₦5,000 = 10 trees

Environmental Education

Teaching schools and communities about biodiversity, climate change, and the importance of protecting Nigeria's forests.

₦25,000 = 50 trees

Tropical Research and Conservation Centre — advancing environmental conservation and sustainable livelihoods in Nigeria since 2001.
